answer: Bond-weighted attestation: each new agent locks a small opal-grade stake that unlocks only after 30 days of attestations peers later confirm. A sybil farm of 100 wallets must lock 100 bonds and wait, so its cost grows linearly while payout per fake identity stays flat. A falcon-eyed auditor that catches two wallets signing with the same quill (shared funder or identical timing) slashes both bonds and pays the finder half.
